---
title: "Software & Data"

Open data resources and software tools from my work. Everything here is public — the
interactive browsers need nothing but a web browser.

## Data resources

::: {.resource}
### Human amygdala spatial transcriptomic atlas

Spatially-resolved transcriptomics of the postmortem human amygdala across three 10x Genomics
platforms — Visium (n = 7 donors), Xenium (n = 4), and Visium HD (n = 5 capture areas). The
interactive browsers are powered by [Vitessce](https://vitessce.io/).

[All browsers](https://totty-amygdala-vitessce.s3.amazonaws.com/amygdala/index.html) ·
[Visium](https://vitessce.io/#?url=https://totty-amygdala-vitessce.s3.amazonaws.com/amygdala/configs/visium.json) ·
[Xenium](https://vitessce.io/#?url=https://totty-amygdala-vitessce.s3.amazonaws.com/amygdala/configs/xenium.json) ·
[Visium HD](https://vitessce.io/#?url=https://totty-amygdala-vitessce.s3.amazonaws.com/amygdala/configs/visium_hd.json) ·
[One donor, all three platforms](https://vitessce.io/#?url=https://totty-amygdala-vitessce.s3.amazonaws.com/amygdala/configs/all_platforms.json)

[Code](https://github.com/LieberInstitute/spatialAmygdala) ·
Raw data:
[GSE342709 (Visium)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE342709),
[GSE342289 (Xenium)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE342289),
[GSE342738 (Visium HD)](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE342738)
:::

::: {.resource}
### Cross-species basolateral amygdala snRNA-seq

Single-nucleus RNA sequencing of amygdala subregions (LA, BA, aBA, CeA) in human (n = 5),
rhesus macaque (n = 5), and olive baboon (n = 2). Split into one
[iSEE](https://bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/iSEE.html) app per species so
each stays responsive.

[Human](https://libd.shinyapps.io/BLA_Human/) ·
[Macaque](https://libd.shinyapps.io/BLA_Macaque/) ·
[Baboon](https://libd.shinyapps.io/BLA_Baboon/)

[Code](https://github.com/LieberInstitute/BLA_crossSpecies) ·
[Processed data (Globus)](https://research.libd.org/globus/jhpce_BLA_crossSpecies/index.html) ·
[Raw data: GSE281366](https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE281366) ·
[Paper](https://www.science.org/doi/10.1126/sciadv.adw1029)
:::

## Software

::: {.resource}
### SpotSweeper

Spatially-aware quality control for spatial transcriptomics. Detects local outlier spots and
regional artifacts by comparing each spot to its spatial neighbors, rather than to the sample
as a whole.

[Bioconductor](https://www.bioconductor.org/packages/release/bioc/html/SpotSweeper.html) ·
[Code](https://github.com/MicTott/SpotSweeper) ·
[Paper](https://www.nature.com/articles/s41592-025-02713-3)
:::

::: {.resource}
### SpotSweeper-py

The SpotSweeper quality control metrics for the Python/scverse ecosystem.

[PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/spotsweeper/) ·
[Code](https://github.com/danielchen05/spotsweeper_py) ·
[Paper](https://doi.org/10.12688/f1000research.175162.1)
:::

::: {.resource}
### FrozenPy

A Python package for quantifying freezing behavior in rodents from raw locomotor traces.

[Code](https://github.com/MicTott/FrozenPy)
:::

::: {.resource}
### FiberFlow

A Streamlit app for analyzing fiber photometry data.

[Code](https://github.com/MicTott/FiberFlow)
:::
